_comment: Tracks which upstream each derived file came from + the commit it was last synced at. To check for upstream changes worth pulling, see references/upstream-sync.md. JSON chosen for LLM-friendly precise edits. historical_sources lists retired upstreams kept for attribution only — not synced.

anthropics-skills.synced_version: none (repo declares no version or tags)

superpowers.note: Retired as a pinned upstream: harry's derived laws and skills have diverged to near-zero shared lines, so tracking yielded only alerts harry mostly declined. v6.3.0 was harvested once before retiring. Kept for attribution of the derived[] entries naming superpowers; do not sync. Re-compare on demand only.

codex-plugin-cc.note: Retired as a pinned upstream: the vendored in-process Codex runtime (src/lib/codex/), ported and modified from this repo, is deleted — ask and review now spawn the codex CLI directly (codex exec / codex exec review) instead of running an in-process session against it. Kept for attribution of the derived[] entries naming codex-plugin-cc; do not sync.

derived.note: All iron laws (TDD/debugging/verification/receiving-review/worktrees/parallel-dispatch/using-superpowers) folded into resident laws + ponytail philosophy recalibrated (correctness>cost). Folded user's CLAUDE.shared.md universal principles.
HARD-GATE; SCQA+tech design into the item's ## Why / What in .local/ (not committed); tier-aware; Major contested → /debate.
merged; tier auto-routes session/subagent (no choice prompt); implementer = CC subagents.
merge-vs-PR always ask; merge flow adds archive + CI monitor; native worktree cleanup first.

merged; default whole-project, --diff for diff-only; §2 contract carve-out (don't flag contracts as over-engineering). Retired as its own command 2026-07 — absorbed into /audit dimension 10 (whole-repo, iterative) and /review --simplify's new lane (quick per-diff); do not re-add a standalone /lean.
redefined as deferral re-judge: reconcile DEBT:/TODO + item deferrals + open backlog, freshness flag, promotion.

REVIEW'S TRUE UPSTREAM IS codex-plugin-cc (copilot review is ported from it), now retired to historical_sources — codex-plugin-cc is not synced any more. review no longer runs any code ported from it: it spawns `codex exec review` directly, read-only. Kept for attribution only.
3-model debate (opus / gpt via Codex / gemini-3.1-pro); judge-panel for Major decisions. No Codex build (the 'self' voice is Claude/opus by design).

runtime commands; setup+status merged into status. Originally had a Copilot premium-quota fallback at <5% remaining; removed along with the Copilot backend. result retired 2026-07 — the background-job subsystem behind it never had a shipped producer (no commit in harry's history ever passed --background to the node CLI), so /harry:result could only ever report no completed jobs and exit 1; /harry:status lost its job tables at the same time and was Codex-rate-limit-only until its own retirement 2026-09-17, when the in-process Codex session it read quota off of (codex-plugin-cc, now historical) was deleted along with it — there is no source left for a quota snapshot. ask itself moved onto spawning `codex exec` directly at the same time, so it no longer runs any code ported from codex-plugin-cc either. Do not re-add a standalone /result or /status without first building a producer.

references/grilling.md is the single source; commands/grill.md + codex-skills/grill are thin doors; brainstorming points at the same file. Harry SHARES upstream's one-question-at-a-time cadence canon (skills/productivity/grilling/SKILL.md:8) — nothing to restore there. HARRY-AUTHORED, with no upstream counterpart: the residue-manifest exit gate, the assumption dispositions (confirmed fact / returned as an open question / pinned by an AC), and the ledger (decided/open/deferred/assumptions) it reads out from; also no question caps (upstream's own out-of-scope ruling). batch-grill-me sits under in-progress/ — its path may move when upstream graduates it.

Secondary distills from the same 2026-07 survey: loop-first debugging discipline into references/root-cause-tracing.md; authoring vocabulary into references/skill-authoring.md; prototype decision aid into brainstorming; seam pre-agreement into references/red-green.md.

Calibration deviations kept: tiered TDD, per-task parallel worktrees, harry's own recap-free structure — see the sp-sync unit records for the 16 declared skips.

2026-07 distills into references/skill-authoring.md: reinvented-helpers bundling signal (e), trigger widening + trigger-eval discipline (d), scoped why-over-MUST + REFACTOR anti-overfit guard (a/e). Deviations kept: WHEN-only descriptions (upstream wants what+when) and (b)/(c) prohibition forms for discipline skills — don't restore either. Scaffolding/packaging/optimization tooling stays delegated to the installed official skill-creator. Licensing is per-skill: port only from Apache-2.0 paths (skills/skill-creator); the document skills are proprietary.
